sshair: hold the right button and drag to turn the view, left-click to turn the building 90 degrees, and a quick right-click to pin i$(br2)t. Once pinned you can drag its axes, or nudge it one block at a time with the X±/Y±/Z± buttons on the right.
Nudge by the block on the right; left click rotates 90 degrees
Confirming takes two clicks: Submit Build on the panel, then Submit in the screen that opens;$(br) afterwards you are back at the bar, ready to place the next one.$(br2)$(bold)Who builds it$()
pages.title: Submitting and clearing

pages.text: The materials come out of your town warehouse, never your inventory. Running short is not a failure: the site waits at Waiting for Ma$(br)terials and carries on once you stock up. A mage of your town does the work, so there is nothing for you to publish or start;

Anything already inside the footprint — another building's wall, furniture you placed — is cleared out with it by Clear box. That swi$(br)tch is on by default, so turn it off on the right before stacking buildings.$(br2)with no mage around, or with the town frozen, work never begins.
